title: Renderer round6: actual resolution and AA controls
scope: Only new research files; frozen0.10 untouched
summary: Windowed/maximized native requests are ready for guarded implementation. Actual fixed/capped MSAA has an identified normal-frame decision boundary preserving replay and resource creation, but needs a separately verified callsite-hook implementation. Fullscreen enumeration has an empty-set recursion edge.

claims.Finding: Native display request takes GX inRCX, pointer to two float32 values inRDX and mode inR8D. Under resizeCS+31432 it copies all needed values into GX request fields and retains no caller buffer. Mode0 performs float32 16:9 fit/truncation; mode2 keeps dimensions unchanged; mode1 enumerates accepted monitor modes and selects exact-or-first. It writes pending dirty by comparing against active mode/dimensions.
claims.Limitations: There is no completion/result token. Mode1 inherits11C970 recursion on an empty mode set; mode0/2 do not call enumeration. Native allocation/device failures occur later.
claims.strength: full fresh ASM plus pseudocode/caller reasoning; original bytes verified
